```suggestion
```
Was this meant to be a draft PR?

```suggestion
```

This is not guaranteed to be available, the module can be disabled, so I suspect this will break if that is done

It would need to be guarded by the module being enabled
That's not what my suggestion is? The include should be removed in the cpp file, you are looking in the wrong file, and the wrong lines
not quite. I guess I left the comment to be clear. But I understand there's no need to be overly clear about that
Yes no don't leave random old code behind, the code should not be a record of past changes
understood

yeah, it was strange for me to see that the TreeSortAndFilterBar class is inside that module. Should it be somewhere else? I've seen other users ask for this feature in other parts of the engine too (like Reparent Node window) just to have in mind

I think it belongs in the module as it's only used there, but it could be moved I guess, but it'd have to be justified and would have to be appropriate for the general editor code, not familiar enough to know if it is actually properly usable outside of the module

But regardless this code will break with that module disabled
If it's going to be used outside the module, it should be in `editor/gui`.

```suggestion
```
Not needed.
Why is this public?
There should be only one filter bar. You can add a setter for the managed Tree to change it when tab changes.

this is related to the other comment. So, when this code was in the module I could just set this pointer to different Trees at runtime. But when I moved the code inside `editor/gui` that caused memory issues. So I guess I left it public from that time. It's better to make a setter that doesnt crash and use one TreeSortAndFilterBar
Forward declare
